name: TVS Motor Company Ltd
about: TVS Motor Company Ltd (TVSM) is engaged in manufacturing two-wheelers and its accessories; it currently manufactures a wide range of two-wheelers and three-wheelers. [1]
keyPoints: Overview[1] The company is in the 2-wheeler industry and is the only company to have a presence in all 3 categories, i.e., motorcycles, scooters, and mopeds, catering to both domestic and international markets. It is also the only company to have a presence in the moped segment for the domestic market.
pros: Company is expected to give good quarter
Company has delivered good profit growth of 38.2% CAGR over last 5 years
Company has a good return on equity (ROE) track record: 3 Years ROE 29.8%
Company has been maintaining a healthy dividend payout of 20.9%
cons: Stock is trading at 19.2 times its book value
Company might be capitalizing the interest cost
